access_ADE20KDataset_METAINFO_classes: access the 150 class names from ADE20KDataset METAINFO for label mapping
access_ADE20KDataset_METAINFO_palette: access the RGB color palette from ADE20KDataset METAINFO for visualization
configure_ADE20KDataset_reduce_zero_labe: configure ADE20KDataset with reduce_zero_label to remap background label zero
